blocks.tamil_translation: due to You alone! You are the One who illuminates the heavens and the earth. All praise is due to You alone! You are the Master of the heavens and the earth; all praise is due to You alone! You alone are the Ever-Lasting. Your promise is true (it does not change), the meeting with You is true, Your word is true, that Jannah exists is true, that Jahannam exists is true, that all the Prophets existed is true, that Muhammad ﷺ existed is true, that Qiyamah is coming is true. O Allah! I have surrendered myself completely to You. I have accepted You with my heart, I have placed my trust in You alone, I have turned to You alone; whomever (of those who do not accept) I disputed with, I disputed only with Your help, and I have brought my case to Your court alone. So forgive my faults that I have committed before this and those I will commit hereafter! Forgive also the sins I committed in secret and openly! It is You who brings forward, and it is You who (by withdrawing Your good help) holds back. There is none other worthy of worship besides You; the power to do good and the strength to keep away from evil come only from Allah,” he would make this Du'a.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَفْضَلُ الصِّيَامِ بَعْدَ رَمَضَانَ، شَهْرُ اللهِ الْمُحَرَّمُ، وَأَفْضَلُ الصَّلوةِ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ، صَلوةُ اللَّيْلِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل صوم المحرم،رقم:٢٧٥٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “After the fasts of Ramadan, the best of fasts is the fasting of the month of Muharram; and after the Fard Salah, the best of Salah is the night prayer.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.
